title: Sep 30 Results + Oct 1 Preview: Split Decision, But Here's Where We Go Next
summary: A 2-2 split on Sep 30, and the Braves are back in our spotlight for Oct 1.

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About Close Calls

September wrapped up with one of those days that reminds you why baseball keeps us all humble. We went 2-2, landing right at 50%, and honestly? Both misses stung a little. The Braves and Astros were sitting at 62% confidence, and both let us down. But the Yankees and Padres came through when it mattered, keeping us steady.

## The Games That Got Away

The Phillies-Braves matchup had us leaning Atlanta at 62%, but Philadelphia had other plans. Same story with the Sox-Astros game—Houston looked good on paper, but the Sox weren't reading from our script.

On the flip side, our Yankees pick at exactly 50% felt like a coin flip that landed our way, and the Padres delivered against the Cubs just like we hoped at 62% confidence.

## Looking Ahead to October 1

Here's where it gets interesting. The Braves and Phillies are running it back tomorrow, and we're not backing down from Atlanta. At 61% confidence, we're giving the Braves another shot at redemption.

Zack Wheeler takes the mound for Philadelphia with a TBD status, while Brent Suter gets the ball for Atlanta. The pitching matchup is still developing, but the model sees something it likes in the Braves' setup at home.

content.value:
## The Story Behind Tomorrow's Pick

It takes guts to double down after a miss, but that's exactly what we're doing. The Phillies-Braves rematch gives Atlanta a chance to prove why we believed in them yesterday, and why we're believing again tomorrow.

The 61% confidence isn't sky-high, but it's strong enough to make this our top pick for the day. Sometimes the best stories are about getting back up after a stumble—and tomorrow, we're betting the Braves feel the same way.

See you back here with the results. Let's start October on the right foot.
